statement: Democratic candidates win a majority of US House seats in the 2026-11-03 midterm elections, with the Associated Press having called at least 218 of 435 seats for Democrats by 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if Associated Press race calls as of 2026-12-15 show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 of 435 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election. FALSE if fewer than 218 are called for Democrats.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates have been called winners in fewer than 218 US House seats as of 2026-12-15, including because races remain uncalled.

statement: CISA adds a Drupal Commerce (Commerce Core) vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry whose vendorProject, product, or vulnerabilityName fields name Drupal and Commerce, with dateAdded between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-27 inclusive. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No KEV entry for a Drupal Commerce vulnerability carries a dateAdded between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-27.

statement: The FBI or the US Treasury Department publicly attributes the October 2026 Binance theft to North Korean state-sponsored actors in an official release dated between 2026-10-30 and 2026-12-04.
